svg.title: 3d Astar State Transition
svg.desc: 3D plot of A* search over (X, Y, orientation theta): three stacked grid layers for theta = 0, 90 and 180 degrees. A path starts at (1, 1, 0 degrees) on the bottom layer, moves within a layer to change position and moves vertically between layers to rotate, ending at the goal (5, 5, 0 degrees) circled in red.
